title: A More Perfect View Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: This two-story one-bedroom penthouse is the definition of coastal living at the beach. Boasting a spectacular view of the Gulf of Mexico and overlooking Seaside’s Central Square, this on of a kind accommodation is fully equipped with a kitchen, dining area, half bath, and living room with access to a furnished porch- all on the first floor.
description_expanded: 25 CENTRAL SQUARE, SUITE 302Front-Row Views & an Iconic Seaside LocationExperience Seaside, Florida from an unmatched vantage point at A More Perfect View, a newly renovated luxury penthouse overlooking the Gulf and Seaside’s iconic Central Square. Located just steps from the sugar-white sand beaches and positioned directly above Town Square, this upscale 2-bedroom Seaside vacation rental offers front-row access to the heart of town. Designed to comfortably sleep up to six guests, this residence delivers a refined yet relaxed coastal escape along Scenic Highway 30A.Stay in the Heart of Seaside, FLPerched above Seaside’s lively Central Square, this penthouse places you within effortless walking distance of award-winning restaurants, charming boutiques, live music, and seasonal events. The famous Coleman Pavilion, your closest beach access, is just moments away. Start your mornings at Amavida Coffee, conveniently located inside the building, and enjoy seamless access to the third-floor residence via a private elevator.Before even entering the home, guests are welcomed by a shared outdoor lounge—recently updated with stylish furnishings and sweeping Gulf views—setting thetone for an elevated Seaside experience.Modern Coastal Living with Designer RenovationsOnce a one-bedroom residence, this penthouse has been completely reimagined into a spacious two-bedroom retreat with thoughtful upgrades throughout. The open-concept main level features a brand-new custom kitchen with an induction cooktop, premium appliances, and a breakfast island with seating for two. A dining area for six flows into the inviting living room, complete with a large Smart TV, upgraded high-speed internet, and a queen sleeper sofa.Step onto the private balcony overlooking Seaside’s amphitheater and Central Square—an ideal spot for sunset views, people-watching, and enjoying the Gulf breeze. A convenient powder bath completes the main living level.Private Bedrooms & Rooftop RelaxationUpstairs, the serene primary suite offers a cozy window nook with panoramic views of Seaside and the Gulf of Mexico. The bedroom includes a Smart TV, generous storage, and a beautifully updated en-suite bathroom with a glass-enclosed walk-in shower.The second bedroom is perfectly suited for families or additional guests, featuring twin bunk beds and a private en-suite bathroom with a tub/shower combination.Continue outdoors to the open-air rooftop patio, furnished with two loungers—ideal for sunrise coffee, afternoon relaxation, or stargazing after a day on the beach.Thoughtful Amenities for a Seamless StayThis Seaside penthouse comfortably sleeps six and offers a private elevator with secure keypad access. Guests are just steps from beach access at Coleman Pavilion and all that Seaside Town Square has to offer. One parking pass is included for first-come, first-served parking behind the building, with paid public parking available nearby for additional vehicles.An Elevated Seaside, Florida Vacation RentalWith exceptional walkability, breathtaking Gulf and town views, and a complete top-to-bottom renovation, A More Perfect View offers a truly elevated vacation experience in one of Seaside’s most desirable locations. Whether you’re here for beach days, dining, shopping, sunsets, or Seaside’s vibrant cultural events, this penthouse places you exactly where you want to be.Book your stay at A More Perfect View and discover Seaside, Florida from its most perfect perspective.* Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum Winter. FEATURES840 square feet of interior living space, plus private patios on both floorsApprox. 167 feet / 2-minute walk to beach accessColeman Pavilion Seaside Beach access, just steps awayStunning Gulf of Mexico views from multiple vantage pointsMedia throughout the residence for seamless entertainmentParking included: one parking pass provided with shared, first-come, first-served parking behind 25 Central Square; additional complimentary parking available on Smolian Circle; extra vehicles may park in paid public areas for a daily ratePeacock Alley linens throughout the home, featuring fresh, luxurious towels and sheetsAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fully equipped fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities provided for arrivalNo pets permitted
